entities.name: Commander Gunamo

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Leader whose attack on the Sylvan Library Gunamo's troops accompanied; she was overwhelmed by the forest.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Place attacked by Ayesha Tanaka and Gunamo's troops.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Military force on Dominaria in which Gunamo was a commander.
